title: Tax Administration Real Estate Sales Data
description:
This table contains property sales information including sale date, price, and amounts for properties within Fairfax County. There is a one-to-many relationship to the parcel data. Refer to this document for descriptions of the data on the table. The sales data is extracted daily from the DTA system.
